In the Issuance of visas and admission
and stay of aliens in order to enable them to obtain visas and/or
status/classification
with ease and speed;
NOW, THEREFORE,
I, CORAZON C. AQUINO,
Philippines,
of the powers vested
In me by law, do hereby
order the amendment of paragraph
I (e) of LOI No. 911, as amended,
I (D) of LOI No. 1093, as amended,
which prohibit
from what is authorized
for temporary
who are holders
of Hongkong-Britlsh,
Macao-Portuguese,
People's Republic
of China or Taipei Passports
Certificates
of Identity,
by deleting
said paragraphs
these foreign
may now be allowed to change admission status
or classification
the necessity
of departing
from the country
and securing
visas from the proper
Philippine
Consulate/Office
This Executive
Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila,
year of our lord,
nineteen hundred
and ninety-two.
